title.value: Guiding The Last Layer in Federated Learning with Pre-Trained Models
title.justification: The title is succinctly stated at the beginning of the paper and accurately reflects the central focus of the research on federated learning and pre-trained models.
title.quote: "Guiding The Last Layer in Federated Learning with Pre-Trained Models"

extractions.description: This paper discusses the use of pre-trained models in the context of Federated Learning (FL) to enhance the performance of models trained across distributed clients while preserving data privacy. It explores the efficiency of using pre-trained models as a starting point, analyzing the benefits of fitting only the last layer and introducing an approach called FedNCM. The study emphasizes communication and computation cost reduction while maintaining strong performance.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The focus of the paper is on improving the efficiency and performance of federated learning models using pre-trained models. While this can have broader implications on sustainability by potentially reducing computational resources, the paper does not directly address Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development goals.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: "FL is an approach in which a common global model is trained by aggregating model updates computed across a set of distributed edge devices whose data is kept private."

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily deals with improving federated learning through pre-trained models, focusing on technical aspects rather than directly addressing any specific Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development theme.
primary_category.quote: "Federated Learning (FL) is an emerging paradigm that allows a model to be trained across a number of participants without sharing data."

secondary_categories.justification: The content of the paper does not extend to any other specific Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development theme.
secondary_categories.quote: "We demonstrate the potential our method has to reduce communication and compute costs while achieving better model performance."

primary_sub_category.justification: There was no direct connection to any specific sub-category related to Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development goals in the context of the technologies discussed in the paper.
primary_sub_category.quote: "In recent years an increased focus on data privacy has attracted significant research interest in Federated Learning (FL)."

secondary_sub_categories.justification: Since there is no primary Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development theme applicable, secondary themes are also not applicable.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: "A key driver of algorithmic development in FL is the reduction of communication cost, having largely motivated the design of the FedAvg algorithm."

applications.value: Reduction of communication and computation costs
applications.justification: The paper highlights the methods proposed to reduce the communication and computing requirements in the context of federated learning, which can indirectly contribute to energy efficiency.
applications.quote: "We propose employing a two-stage process... results in faster convergence and higher accuracy without violating FL constraints."

new_primary_category.justification: There was no need to introduce a new category as the paper does not align with the existing Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development categories.
new_primary_category.quote: "Transfer learning from pre-trained models that have been trained on sufficiently abundant and diverse data is well known to produce state-of-the-art results."

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not address topics that require the creation of a new sub-category under Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: "We demonstrate how to get the best of both HeadTuning and fine-tuning in the FL setting."
